items.title: Presentation: Wrangling Telemetry at Scale: A Guide to Self-Hosted Observability
items.blurb: Colin Douch shares battle-tested strategies for building and scaling self-hosted observability stacks.

items.title: Introducing the Cloudflare PHP Capture the Flag challenge
items.blurb: We are launching a PHP Capture the Flag challenge integrated with our Bug Bounty program to test our WAF protections. Security researchers are invited to bypass our defenses and capture the flag to help make the Internet safer.

items.title: What took the Internet offline in Q3 2026
items.blurb: An examination of global Internet disruptions observed by Cloudflare Radar during the third quarter of 2026. This review analyzes how power failures, natural disasters, and government shutdowns impacted network connectivity and traffic.

items.title: How the fastest-growing enterprises on Stripe scale globally
items.blurb: Despite slower global economic growth and greater geopolitical fragmentation, the fastest-growing enterprises continue to look beyond their home markets and are investing in tools and workflows that make expansion faster and more…
